## Dell AI, Cloud, and Productivity Updates

Dell is emphasizing AI-ready infrastructure, enterprise PCs, storage platforms, and lifecycle services for hybrid IT environments.

## AI Product Launches
- PowerEdge AI servers: Infrastructure for GPU-accelerated AI workloads
- Dell AI Factory positioning: Solutions combining compute, storage, networking, and services
- AI PCs: Commercial endpoints for productivity and local AI use cases

## Productivity Updates
- ProSupport and managed services to reduce IT operations burden
- Hybrid cloud infrastructure for workload flexibility
- Storage automation and data management improvements

## Enterprise Features
- Infrastructure scale: Servers, storage, networking, and data protection portfolio
- Financing and lifecycle services: Options for refresh planning and asset management
- Partner ecosystem: NVIDIA, VMware ecosystem history, Microsoft, and cloud partners
